claim.claim-text: 1. A device for use in a wireless communication system, the device comprising:
a communication module; and a processor configured to control the communication module, wherein the processor is configured to:

receive scheduling information for a physical uplink shared channel, PUSCH, transmission; receive a group common physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, including an uplink, LTL, preemption indicator at a monitoring time, the LTL preemption indicator indicating at least one resource part to be preempted within a reference UL resource; and cancel at least a part of the PUSCH transmission based on the at least one resource part, wherein the reference LTL resource is started in time after an offset from the monitoring time, and a value of the offset is associated with a PUSCH processing time.
2. A device for use in a wireless communication system, the device comprising:
a communication module; and a processor configured to control the communication module, wherein the processor is configured to:

transmit scheduling information for a physical uplink shared channel, PUSCH, reception; transmit a group common physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, including an uplink, LTL, preemption indicator at a monitoring time, wherein the LTL preemption indicator indicates at least one resource part to be preempted within a reference UL resource; and disregard at least a part of the PUSCH reception based on the at least one resource part, wherein the reference LTL resource is started in time after an offset from the monitoring time, and a value of the offset is associated with a PUSCH processing time.

3. The device of claim 1 or 2, wherein the reference LTL resource excludes a downlink symbol configured by a semi-static downlink/uplink, DL/UL, assignment, and/or wherein the at least a part of the PUSCH transmission includes at least one symbol corresponding to the at least one resource part.
4. The device of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the PUSCH processing time is a minimum time required from a reception of a PDCCH for scheduling the PUSCH and to a transmission of the PUSCH.

5. The device of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the UL preemption indicator includes a bitmap including N bits, and each of the N bits corresponds to a respective one of N resource parts within the reference UL resource,

wherein each of one or more first resource parts among the N resource parts is configured to have P symbols, and each of remaining second resource parts among the N resource parts is configured to have Q symbols, wherein P and Q are set so that a difference between P and Q is to be at most 1, and wherein N, P and Q are natural numbers.

6. The device of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the UL preemption indicator includes a bitmap including N bits, and each of the N bits corresponds to a respective one of N resource parts within the reference UL resource,

wherein each of mod (S, N) resource parts among the N resource parts includes ceil (S/N) symbols, and each of N-mod (S, N) resource parts among the N resource parts includes floor (S/N) symbols, and wherein S is a number of symbols within the reference UL resource, N is a natural number, mod () represents a modulo function, ceil () represents a ceiling function, and floor () represents a flooring function.
7. The device of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the reference UL resource is started at an earliest symbol after the offset from the monitoring time.
8. A method performed by a user equipment, UE, in a wireless communication system, the method comprising:

receiving scheduling information for a physical uplink shared channel, PUSCH, transmission; receiving a group common physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, including an, uplink, LTL, preemption indicator at a monitoring time, the UL preemption indicator indicating at least one resource part to be preempted within a reference UL resource; and canceling at least a part of the PUSCH transmission based on the at least one resource part, wherein the reference LTL resource is started in time after an offset from the monitoring time, and a value of the offset is associated with a PUSCH processing time.
9. A method performed by a base station, BS, in a wireless communication system, the method comprising:

transmitting scheduling information for a physical uplink shared channel, PUSCH, reception; transmitting a group common physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, including an uplink, LTL, preemption indicator at a monitoring time, wherein the LTL preemption indicator indicates at least one resource part to be preempted within a reference UL resource; and disregarding at least a part of the PUSCH reception based on the at least one resource part, wherein the reference UL resource is started in time after an offset from the monitoring time, and a value of the offset is associated with a PUSCH processing time.

10. The method of claim 8 or 9, wherein the reference UL resource excludes a downlink symbol configured by a semi-static downlink/uplink, DL/UL, assignment, and/or wherein the at least a part of the PUSCH transmission includes at least one symbol corresponding to the at least one resource part.
11. The method of any one of claims 8 to 10, wherein the PUSCH processing time is a minimum time required from a reception of a PDCCH for scheduling the PUSCH and to a transmission of the PUSCH.

12. The method of any one of claims 8 to 11, wherein the LTL preemption indicator includes a bitmap including N bits, and each of the N bits corresponds to a respective one of N resource parts within the reference UL resource,

wherein each of one or more first resource parts among the N resource parts is configured to have P symbols, and each of remaining second resource parts among the N resource parts is configured to have Q symbols, wherein P and Q are set so that a difference between P and Q is to be at most 1, and wherein N, P and Q are natural numbers.

13. The method of any one of claims 8 to 12, wherein the UL preemption indicator includes a bitmap including N bits, and each of the N bits corresponds to a respective one of N resource parts within the reference UL resource,

wherein each of mod (S, N) resource parts among the N resource parts includes ceil (S/N) symbols, and each of N-mod (S, N) resource parts among the N resource parts includes floor (S/N) symbols, and wherein S is a number of symbols within the reference UL resource, N is a natural number, mod () represents a modulo function, ceil () represents a ceiling function, and floor () represents a flooring function.
14. The method of any one of claims 8 to 13, wherein the reference UL resource is started at an earliest symbol after the offset from the monitoring time.
